system.description:
Target takes [Rigor]. 

(Target: Dazed, Staggered): The target can not attack at close range. This effect is handled as Life Status with the [Sealed] tag, and it continues until the target consumes 2 [Fate Points].

A special skill that wields a sword and creates a terrifying illusion from the void to make the enemy cower. It is said that many opponents can see the fierce tiger roaring as if it is about to jump.
